The CI failure was caused by downstream consumers (`analytics-ingest` and `billing-service`) still requiring the legacy field names (`placedAt` and `totalCents`) under contract validation rule **ARCH-4**.

To maintain backwards compatibility while introducing the new field names matching the Payments and Customer APIs, [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w4/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L30) now dual-emits both the new fields (`createdAt`, `amountCents`) and the legacy aliases (`placedAt`, `totalCents`).

### Changes Made
1. **[`src/core/events.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w4/r/src/core/events.ts)**:
   - Added `createdAt` and `amountCents` to [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w4/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L30).
   - Retained `placedAt` and `totalCents` on [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w4/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L30) as legacy aliases for consumer backwards compatibility.
   - Updated [`orderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w4/r/src/core/events.ts#L46-L66) to populate both the new and legacy fields.
2. **[`test/app.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w4/r/test/app.test.ts)** and **[`test/adapters.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w4/r/test/adapters.test.ts)**:
   - Updated test assertions to verify that both the new fields (`createdAt`, `amountCents`) and legacy fields (`placedAt`, `totalCents`) are correctly present on emitted `OrderPlaced` events.

### Verification
- `npm test`: Passed (all 39 tests passing).
- `npm run typecheck`: Passed.
- `npm run arch`: Passed (dependency rules satisfied).
